annotations.title: The exact total for finishing the move (free)

description: Shows exactly what finalising this app costs: the tier for its page count (the matching data move is included), the 20% extra-app discount (never more than the app's build cost) when this account finalised another app in the last 12 months, each add-on and change switched on in nc_basket, bundles, and the total in USD, with, for key holders, the prepaid balance and whether it covers it. Nothing is charged by this tool. It also states the daily upload allowance (and for key holders, uploads_left_today). You pay once by card at Stripe checkout (the Finalise button on the preview page), or, with an App Mover key that holds credits, from those credits. A part that fails its automatic check is refunded; for the refund policy, ask for a full refund before the first page of the paid build is built, 50% after the build starts, within 30 days. Paying starts the full build straight away; the Cloudflare and R2 details are asked right after payment and never block it. Pages still under the pass mark get a retry round from a stronger model.

job_id.description: The job_id from nc_connect. The app file must already be uploaded and planned.

job_secret.description: The job_secret returned when this job was made (or the job's signed editor link). Required with job_id when no API key is sent: the job_id alone does not open a job.

mode.description: automatic (default): every page rebuilt and deployed. developer: the briefs and the generated backend only, for the owner's own AI assistant to build the pages.
